product.ta-alphatronic-p10.summary: The Alphatronic P10 was the starting model for the P10-S branch.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10.history: Triumph-Adler included it in its office range and reused its manual as the basis for the P10-S in 1986.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10.technical.con: The system ROM consists of two 16 KiB blocks. MAME loads them consecutively at offsets 0x8000 and 0xC000 in its BIOS region.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10.technical.ver: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10.technical.lim: The system ROMs are preserved and hash-checked. Original media and startup verification in BluMach remain pending.
product.ta-alphatronic-p10.technical.sou: Austauschseiten für Bedienhandbuch Alphatronic P10 nach P10-S · 08/1986
